tailoring.headline: Techno-Functional E-Commerce Specialist | Product Catalog, PIM & Data Pipelines | SAP Commerce Cloud
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional e-commerce professional with 5+ years of experience delivering catalog, navigation, and backend data solutions for enterprise platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell. Proven track record aligning international business and IT teams: translating complex catalog and taxonomy requirements into detailed user stories, functional specifications, and data pipelines. Combines hands-on expertise in product catalogs, PIM integrations, and feed architecture with SAP Commerce Cloud Developer and Business User certifications to drive scalable digital discovery.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Product Manager - Ecommerce Categories (f/m/d)
cover_en.hook: Decathlon Digital's ambition to unify global navigation and empower intuitive discovery resonates strongly with my background. Bringing 5+ years of hands-on e-commerce experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bridge business requirements and engineering execution to build scalable product catalog ecosystems.

bullets.label: Catalog & PIM Architecture
bullets.text: Designed and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders, and DataHub to synchronize complex product catalogs across global channels, maintaining strict data consistency across multi-level feeds.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Product Ownership
bullets.text: Collaborated directly with business stakeholders, product owners, and engineering teams to map processes, translate business needs into epics and user stories, author functional specifications, and steer user acceptance testing.

bullets.label: Migration & System Standardization
bullets.text: Engineered migrations across account and catalog data structures to resolve integration bottlenecks across ERP, MDM, and e-commerce platforms, partnering with cross-functional international squads.

bullets.label: Search & Navigation Performance
bullets.text: Configured Apache Solr search indexing and executed database query refactoring that reduced latency, ensuring high-performing navigation and discovery across high-volume digital storefronts.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit, currently serving my notice period with an earliest start date of 16 December 2026. I welcome the opportunity to discuss how my catalog and techno-functional experience can support Decathlon's Categories squad.

tailoring.why_company: Decathlon's mission to make sports accessible through an intuitive digital discovery experience matches my passion for e-commerce catalog architecture. Unifying fragmented catalog treeviews into a high-performing Core Navigation is an exciting challenge where techno-functional rigor directly impacts customer experience. Decathlon Digital's scale and global vision offer the ideal environment to deliver robust, customer-centric product taxonomy.
tailoring.motivation_short: Motivated to bring 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce catalog and PIM integration experience to Decathlon Digital, bridging business discovery goals with robust engineering delivery to build an intuitive, unified navigation ecosystem for global sports shoppers.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, I noticed Decathlon Digital is seeking a Product Manager for Ecommerce Categories. With 5+ years bridging business requirements, PIM integrations, and catalog architectures at Rockwell and Shell, I would love to connect and discuss how I can support your squad.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Product Manager - Ecommerce Categories (f/m/d) - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Product Manager - Ecommerce Categories (f/m/d) position at Decathlon Digital.

With over 5 years of techno-functional e-commerce experience spanning catalog architecture, PIM data pipelines, and agile backlog management for enterprise platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how my background matches your squad's goals.

Thank you for your time and consideration.
